name: chezmoi
description: Guards chezmoi-managed dotfiles as a hook. Refuses an Edit, Write or NotebookEdit whose target is a chezmoi destination file, and names the source file to edit instead. Edits inside the chezmoi source directory always pass. The managed list is cached for 30 minutes, and the hook fails open whenever chezmoi is missing, uninitialised or errors. Requires jq and chezmoi.
